groups.name: camunda.client.threads
groups.description: Properties for the threading behavior of the Camunda client.

groups.name: camunda.client.threads.virtual
groups.description: Properties for virtual-thread job handling of the Camunda client.

properties.name: camunda.client.threads.virtual.enabled
properties.description: Whether job handling uses Java 21 virtual threads. Enabled by default when the camunda-spring-boot-starter-virtual-threads module is on the classpath. Set to false to fall back to the default platform-thread executor sized by camunda.client.execution-threads.
